# Built by Miguel

> High-performance React web engineering, Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization, and automated dispatch workflows for local service contractors. Founded and led by Miguel Umbac.

## Core Services & Technical Capabilities

- [SEO & Organic Search Visibility](/seo): SEO systems that compound into customer calls and pipeline revenue. Includes [Local SEO & Google Maps](/seo/local), [National & Regional SEO](/seo/national), and [AI Search Optimization (AEO / GEO)](/seo/aeo-geo).
- [Custom React Websites & Web Engineering](/websites): Fast edge-hosted web applications built with TypeScript, React, and Tailwind CSS. Includes [Website Design & Development](/websites/design-and-development) and [Website Hosting & Care](/websites/hosting-and-maintenance).
- [Systems & Workflow Automation](/systems-auto): Automated lead dispatch pipelines that alert contractor phones via SMS, sync CRM records, and automate client intake.
- [Case Studies & Technical Proof](/work): Verified ranking turnarounds, geo-grid heatmap expansions, and Core Web Vitals performance benchmarks.
- [About Miguel Umbac](/about): Background, engineering philosophy, and direct founder promise.
- [Free 5-Minute Video Audit](/audit): Personalized 24-hour video breakdown analyzing local Google Maps ranking, mobile speed bottlenecks, and competitor gap analysis.
